```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/youtube.com/comments
Headers:
    x-apikey: your_api_key_here
Query Params:
    limit=10
    continuation_cursor=abc
```

Replace `your_api_key_here` with `"my_api"` and send the request (e.g., via curl, Postman, or your preferred HTTP client). If you run into trouble interpreting the response, feel free to share the JSON payload and I can help walk through it!
